caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Expulsion of main body of Yüe-chi horde from Kan-suh by the Hiung-nū.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Nan-tiu-mi, chief of the Wu-sun, killed by the Yüe-chi.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Yüe-chi occupation of the Śaka territory ; Śaka migration.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Expulsion of Yüe-chi from Śaka territory by Koen-muo, the young Wu-sun chief, son of Nan-tiu-mi.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Reduction of the Ta-hia, both north and south of the Oxus, to vassalage by the Yüe-chi, who begin to settle down.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Dispatch by Chinese emperor Wu-ti of Chang-k'ien as envoy to the Yüe-chi.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Arrival of Chang-k'ien at Yüe-chi head-quarters, north of the Oxus.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Extension of Yüe-chi settlements to the lands south of the Oxus ; occupation of Ta-hia capital, Lan-sheu, south of the river, probably = Balkh.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Formation of five Yüe-chi principalities, including Kushān and Bāmiān.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Epoch of the Mālava or Vikrama era.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: A Chinese official instructed in Buddhist books by a Yüe-chi king. (See Franke, Türkvölker, p. 92 n.)

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Temporary cessation of intercourse between China and the West.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Augustus, Roman emperor, died ; Tiberius acc.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: End of First, or Early Han dynasty of China.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Consolidation of the five Yüe-chi principalities into one Kushān kingdom under Kadphises I ; conquest by him of Kao-fū (Kābul), Ki-pin (Gandhāra), and Pota (? Bactria or more probably Arachosia).

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Destruction of Indo-Parthian power, and gradual conquest of Northern India by Kadphises I.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Kadphises I succeeded Gondophernes at Taxila.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Buddhist books sent for by Chinese emperor, Ming-ti.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Galba, Otho, and Vitellius, Roman emperors.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Victorious career of Pan-chao, the Chinese general, in Khotan, &c.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Epoch of the Śaka or Sālivāhana era ; Kadphises I died, aged 80 ; Kadphises II Kushān (Yen-kao-ching, Wema Kadphises, &c.), his son, acc.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Defeat of Kadphises II by Pan-chao.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Reduction of Kuchā and Kara-shahr by the Chinese under Pan-chao.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Indian embassy to Trajan; Buddhist Council.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Overthrow by the Romans of the Nabataean kingdom of Petra in Arabia; rise of Palmyra.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Hadrian, Roman emperor, acc.; retrocession of Meso-potamia.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Kanishka Kushān, acc.; year 1 of his regnal era.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: War of Hadrian with the Jews.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Mānikyāla inscription of Kanishka (year 18); Antoninus Pius, Roman emperor, acc.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Jūnāgaṛh inscription of Rudradāman, Western satrap.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Death of Kanishka; Huvishka Kushān, acc. as sovereign of whole empire.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Marcus Aurelius Antoninus, Roman emperor, acc.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Defeat of Parthian king, Vologeses III, by the Romans.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Foundation of Sassanian empire of Persia by Ardashīr or Artaxerxes I.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Defeat of Valerian, Roman emperor, by Sapor I.

caption: APPROXIMATE KUSHĀN CHRONOLOGY 1
raw_text: Successful siege of Amida by Sapor II, with Kushān help.
